watch.summary: The streamer gets scored on in Rocket League and goes on a passionate rant mocking opponent excuses about being rusty.

beats.what: Opponent scores a goal in Rocket League.
Streamer starts complaining about opponents who claim they haven't played recently.
Streamer states that if someone says they haven't played, they are secretly good.
Streamer does an exaggerated impression of gamers making excuses about broken controllers and being cold.
Streamer scores a goal back to even the score.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Once they start telling you about how they haven't played in some minutes, just know that they are good.
watch.why: The streamer passionately calls out a universally relatable gaming trope where opponents claim to be rusty before playing well. His animated gestures and mocking gamer excuses make the commentary entertaining to any audience.
